ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In ARABIC LANGUAGE, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

2. When practising Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.

3. When practising Guided Reading: Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Reading: Fluency.

   C. Use insults to “practise” Guided Reading: Fluency.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Guided Reading: Fluency.

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.

7. When practising Language Use, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language Use.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Language Use.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Language Use.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Use.

8. When practising Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions, which approach is best? (1 mark)

----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
